sources.note: Finds that ternary post-training quantization of a reasoning model collapses because the calibration set is web text, and repairs it by calibrating on chain-of-thought traces the target model generates for itself.
sources.title: Attend to Your Own Thoughts: Breaking the Barrier for Post-Training Quantization of Reasoning LLMs through the Lens of 1.58-Bit Quantization

sources.note: Uses chain-of-thought about required capabilities as training-time supervision for a skill retriever -- distilled from a teacher in stage one and refined by retrieval-rewarded GRPO in stage two -- so that at inference the model encodes the bare query with no generation at all.
sources.title: SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval for Implicit User Requests

sources.note: Argues that faithfulness alone is insufficient for CoT monitoring and adds verbosity — whether the trace lists every factor needed to solve the task — combining the two into a monitorability score, then shows models can look faithful while omitting key factors.
sources.title: Measuring Chain-of-Thought Monitorability Through Faithfulness and Verbosity

sources.note: Converts AMC23 and AIME24/25 into symbolic templates whose constants are replaced by sampled variables, requires a model to solve several instantiations of each problem, and finds RL-finetuned models lose most of their reported accuracy under that consistency requirement.
sources.title: VAR-MATH: Probing True Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs via Symbolic Multi-Instance Benchmarks

result.definition: A large mixture-of-experts Qwen3 model, used across 4 sources as a frontier-scale open system. Two archived results place it. As a teacher it is substantially worse than a competing frontier model for one safety pipeline -- 51.25 against 14.25 attack success on the same benchmark -- which is that paper's evidence that its framework is partly a property of the teacher's analyses. And under symbolic variabilisation it is among the most robust models on the easier competition set at -6.4 percent, alongside other frontier systems, while the archive's related caution is that the same family degrades sharply on the harder sets. It also appears as a quality auditor in benchmark construction and as a monitorability subject.
